nights.title: Allie Sherlock - Now I've Said It Tour
nights.name: Allie Sherlock
nights.extract: Allie Sherlock is an Irish singer, guitarist, songwriter, and busker. A video of her performing a cover of Ed Sheeran's "Supermarket Flowers" went viral on YouTube in June 2017. Sherlock has performed frequently on Grafton Street in Dublin, Ireland.
